## Summary

The repository is Spring PetClinic REST (OfficeFloor conversion). The `customerCode` is built at owner-creation time by a function step, and `membershipNumber` is derived in the MapStruct mapper. The current implementation uses a **global** sequence and `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` format, but the test files (Cp09/Cp14/Cp16) describe a **target** `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` per-city format that is not yet implemented — those tests would currently fail.

## 1 & 2. Files referencing customerCode / membership

Main:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` (wires the `assignCustomerCode` step)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` (schema docs for `customerCode` / `membershipNumber` / `membershipTier`)

Test:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/Cp09Tests.java` (customerCode per-city sequence)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/Cp16Tests.java` (customerCode city-prefix format)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/Cp14Tests.java` (membershipNumber)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/Cp15Tests.java` (membershipTier)

## 3 & 4. Current customerCode algorithm

`AssignCustomerCode.java` (lines 13-21) — the exact current logic:

```java
public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
    String lastName = owner.getLastName();
    String last3 = lastName.substring(0, Math.min(3, lastName.length())).toUpperCase();
    int sequence = ownerRepository.findAll().size() + 1;
    owner.setCustomerCode(String.format("%s-%04d", last3, sequence));
}
```

Current format: `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` where LAST3 = upper-cased first 3 letters of lastName, NNNN = a **global** 4-digit zero-padded sequence = `findAll().size() + 1` (counts ALL owners, not per-city). Runs before `save`, so the new owner isn't yet counted. Docstring lines 7-12 confirm this.

Note the divergence: the tests expect `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` with a **per-city** sequence:
- Cp16 line 16: `matches("[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\\d{4}")`
- Cp09 lines 24-26: two Sydney owners → `SYD-ALP-` / `SYD-BRA-` with consecutive NNNN, parsed via `ca.substring(8)` (so NNNN begins at index 8, i.e. after `SYD-ALP-`).

### Membership number (derived, not stored)

`OwnerMapper.java` lines 25-26:

```java
@Mapping(target = "membershipNumber",
        expression = "java((owner.getCustomerCode() == null || owner.getRegistrationDate() == null) ? null : owner.getCustomerCode() + \"-M\" + String.format(\"%02d\", owner.getRegistrationDate().getYear() % 100))")
```

Format: `<customerCode>-M<YY>` (YY = last two digits of `registrationDate` year), null if either `customerCode` or `registrationDate` is null. This is format-agnostic to the customerCode change (Cp14 recomputes from returned fields). Membership tier (lines 27-28): `SILVER` when `namesakeCount == 0` and email present, else `BRONZE`.

## 5. Repository / owner-counting methods

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/OwnerRepository.java` — interface methods:
- `Collection<Owner> findByLastName(String lastName)` (line 46) and paged variant (line 48)
- `Owner findById(int id)` (line 57)
- `void save(Owner owner)` (line 66)
- `Collection<Owner> findAll()` (line 74) and `Page<Owner> findAll(Pageable)` (line 76)
- `void delete(Owner owner)` (line 84)

There is **no `findByCity` or `countBy...` method**. Counting is done in-memory: `AssignCustomerCode` uses `findAll().size()`, and `AssignNamesakeCount.java` (lines 16-27) iterates `ownerRepository.findAll()` filtering by name. A per-city count would similarly need to iterate `findAll()` filtering on `existing.getCity()` (no dedicated query exists).

## 6. Owner entity and City field

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`:
- City field (lines 42-44): `@Column(name = "city") @NotEmpty private String city;`
- Getter/setter `getCity()` / `setCity(String)` (lines 77-83)
- `customerCode` field (lines 57-58): `@Column(name = "customer_code") private String customerCode;` with getter/setter lines 109-115
- Related derived-support fields: `registrationDate` (54-55), `namesakeCount` (63-64), `householdId` (60-61). `Owner extends Person` (firstName/lastName live on `Person`).

`getCity()` is also consumed in `ValidateOwnerFields.java:47` and set in `ApplyOwner.java:11`; the POST pipeline order (`owners.POST.yml`) is validate → ensureUniqueTelephone → ensureUniqueHousehold → build → assignHousehold → **assignCustomerCode** → assignNamesakeCount → save → respond, all under `govern: [ transaction ]`.
